_about: Seneca in English, translator per title: Aubrey Stewart (Bohn: On Benefits; Minor Dialogues with On Clemency), Roger L'Estrange (Morals, 1678), John Clarke (Quaestiones Naturales as Physical Science in the Time of Nero, 1910), Frank Justus Miller (the Tragedies, verse, 1907), Ella Isabel Harris (Medea and Daughters of Troy), Elizabeth Twining Hall (Octavia, dubious), W. H. D. Rouse (Apocolocyntosis; Gutenberg clears it as US PD; Rouse d. 1950). All clean Gutenberg. Charles W. Super's De Providentia (1899, with Plutarch's De Sera Numinis Vindicta) added 2026-10-02. Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives.
